column1: # mapping_set_title: "EU AI Act Annex VIII Section C (Art.49(3)) <-> SEMIC vocabularies"

# mapping_set_description: "Maps the 5 information items of Annex VIII Section C (deployer of high-risk AI systems, public authorities, Art.49(3)) to MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0, Schema.org and DPV EU AI Act. The sbom: bridge concept in see_also provides the shared abstraction."

column8: Deployer identity maps to prov:wasAssociatedWith on the deployment activity; MLDCAT-AP does not have a dedicated deployer concept

column2: Submitter acting on behalf of deployer (C.2)
column8: Submitter acting on behalf of the deployer; PROV-O delegation relationship; analogous to A.2/B.2 submitter on behalf of provider
URL of the provider's entry in the EU AI Act database; a persistent identifier for the system registration
FRIA summary (fundamental rights impact) is conceptually related to MLDCAT-AP HarmRisk; no exact MLDCAT-AP property for a formal FRIA document
DPIA summary relates to data protection legal basis and risk; dpv:hasLegalBasis is the nearest DPV/MLDCAT-AP adjacent concept; no direct MLDCAT-AP DPIA field

column2: Submitter acting on behalf of deployer (C.2)
column8: The deployer on whose behalf the submitter acts; eu-aiact:AIDeployer (Art.3(4)) is the deploying entity; relatedMatch because C.2 refers to the submitter, not the deployer directly
eu-aiact:AIDeployer (Art.3(4) EU AI Act) is the entity deploying the AI system in a specific context — exact semantic match for the C.1 deployer registration field

eu-aiact:FRIA (Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment) is explicitly defined in Art.27 EU AI Act — exact semantic match for the C.4 FRIA summary field; replaces the prior relatedMatch to mldcatap:HarmRisk
